Trump defended his White House renovations, telling Alcindor, who is Black, that she would “never notice broken windows, obviously, from where you come,” a remark that drew criticism as racially charged. When Alcindor pressed him on his administration's responsibility for the aviation disruptions, Trump called her “pathetic” and defended the time he spent overseeing renovations.
